name: immunity-wars
description: The Immunity Wars — cooperative immunology board game, digital edition

scripts.coverage:corpus: vitest run --config vitest.coverage.config.ts --coverage tests/equivalence/src/spread.test.ts -t "600 recorded bot games"
scripts.coverage:generators: vitest run --config vitest.coverage.config.ts --coverage tests/equivalence/src/spread.test.ts tests/equivalence/src/actions.test.ts tests/equivalence/src/queries.test.ts tests/equivalence/src/construct.test.ts
scripts.comment:coverage:positions: The half of the coverage documents that can be checked WITHOUT running coverage. Their entries record a file and a line beside the source text that was there; a line inserted above an arm moves every position below it, so the generated documents go stale with nothing about coverage having changed. pnpm verify does not run coverage, so that staleness was invisible locally and red on CI instead: PR #70, where the gate itself passed and four schema.ts numbers had moved. Milliseconds, no coverage run. Four controls: pnpm ci:selftest coverage-positions-shifted (a line prepended to a source file must go red), coverage-positions-untouched (the same line appended must stay green), coverage-positions-no-globs, coverage-positions-unresolvable.
scripts.comment:perf:full: The mandatory full-UI per-redraw re-measure (brief §4): the dev shell must be running (pnpm --filter @immunity-wars/app dev). Writes JSON to stdout; record it in docs/P2_3_MEASUREMENT.md.
scripts.comment:look:frames: Stage L4: the play screen's frames, counted on this machine by the page at /measure.html (the same page Shantanu opens on the S25). Needs `vite preview` of a build on 4173. `--control` makes every frame waste 40 ms and requires slow frames to be reported.
scripts.comment:guide:seed: Stage L6: the guided game's dice, found by search. Plays the whole lesson (packages/content/src/guide/lesson.json) against the real engine for each seed and says which play it and why the others do not. Run it when tests/session/src/lesson.test.ts says the lesson's seed no longer plays it, and put a seed it prints into the lesson's file.
scripts.comment:guide:walk: Stage L6: the guided game walked as a player led by it. Opens the built app on a phone-sized screen, starts the lesson from the title and presses only what the guide lights, to the lesson's end; requires every beat in the lesson's order, the guide gone and the game handed over at the next turn. Against http://localhost:4173 by default, or --build to build and serve the app itself. Controls: pnpm ci:selftest guide-walk-names-a-stuck-beat.
scripts.comment:android:web: The Android shell (docs/LOOK_PLAN.md section 26): the app's web build made for the shell, into packages/android/www. The whole game, with no service worker and no developer's page but the measuring page. Built, never committed.
scripts.comment:android:apk: Builds the Android app: android:web, copied into the native project, and a debug app from it. With --install, puts it on the one phone connected by USB and opens it. Needs JAVA_HOME (a Java 21, checked before Gradle starts) and ANDROID_HOME: packages/android/README.md. Control: pnpm ci:selftest android-java-is-checked-first.
scripts.comment:art:icon: The app's icon (docs/LOOK_PLAN.md section 26, docs/ASSETS.md): from tools/art-pipeline/icon/source.png, every file Android and the store ask for. The picture's ground is measured from its border (refused if the border is not one colour) and the smallest circle round everything else is scaled to the 66 dp circle no launcher cuts. packages/android/src/shell.test.ts holds the files to their sizes.
scripts.comment:android:check: The Android shell, checked on the one phone on the cable (tools/perf/shell-check.ts): the installed debug app starts with no error and no service worker, and Android's back goes to the game first. With --measure, the measuring page read inside the shell. Needs a phone, so it is in no gate; seen to fail on the build before back was handled.
scripts.comment:gate1:audit: Gate 1's machine-checkable half against the app shell on the PREVIEW of the shipped build (pnpm --filter @immunity-wars/app build:web, then preview): touch targets, contrast, text at 200% under both mechanisms (FONT200 the default-font-size preference, ZOOM200 Chrome for Android's page zoom at 180px), offline. Every check's controls, fires and passes, run first or it stops. Record in docs/GATE1_AUDIT.md.
scripts.comment:test:balance: Checks this engine against the MEASURED bands in tests/balance/bands.json. Calibrating is a different, deliberate command (`npx tsx tests/balance/metrics-run.ts`) and deliberately NOT this one — a harness that recalibrated on every run would overwrite its own reference and could never fail. Wiring this into CI is Task F's.
scripts.comment:measure:query-payload: P2.1 decision C. Sizes the precomputed answers to all 22 UI queries against viewState, on real command-phase states, with the distribution per difficulty and the per-query decomposition. Reuses E1's instrument and E's game driver. REPORTS ONLY — nothing gates on it.
scripts.comment:measure:selection-cost: P2.1 decision C, the two conditions on the selection-scoped ruling. Times a selection-triggered view rebuild against the brief §4 redraw budget, and measures whether the same scoping applies to productionBreakdown. REPORTS ONLY.
scripts.comment:test:property: The fast tier already runs inside `pnpm test` via turbo. This is the >=10,000-game tier PHASE1_BRIEF.md section 9 asks for: slow, on demand, and exiting non-zero if any invariant finished having checked nothing. Same two-tier arrangement as the equivalence corpus. Wiring it into a CI tier is Task F's.
scripts.comment:test:manifest-controls: Mutates tests/suites.json six ways and requires manifest.test.ts to redden EXACTLY the assertions each mutation targets — not merely to go red, which would only prove the file is read. Deliberately NOT in `pnpm test`: it shells out to vitest, and a suite that recursively runs itself takes forever. Run it when the manifest or its schema changes.
scripts.comment:ci:selftest: Mutates one file, runs one gate, requires it to FAIL WITH THE RIGHT DIAGNOSTIC, and reverts. A CI pipeline that has never gone red is not known to work, and the usual way to prove it — pushing a broken commit — marks the branch history forever. Not in `pnpm test`: it shells out to the gates, including a full typecheck and lint per control.
scripts.comment:docs:check: The documentation sweep, as a check rather than a habit. CLAUDE.md said 'Current phase: Phase 1' for the whole first session of Phase 2 and ROADMAP.md agreed with it; a stale phase marker is not wrong enough to notice, so it survives. Checks the phase marker resolves and agrees with the brief it names, that every test package reaches tests/suites.json, and that every relative markdown link resolves. It does NOT read prose. Runs inside pnpm verify.
scripts.comment:medical:review: Regenerates docs/MEDICAL_REVIEW.md — every scientific claim the app makes, prose and rules alike, for review by a clinician. NOT a check: it compiles, it does not judge. Reviewer verdicts live in docs/MEDICAL_REVIEW_GUIDE.md, which is hand written and never regenerated.
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm boundaries && pnpm docs:check && pnpm coverage:positions && pnpm turbo:check && pnpm deps:check && pnpm art:clay:check && pnpm ci:selftest:inert && pnpm test
scripts.comment:seam:homes: P2.1 step 2. Classifies the 49 names v2_ui.html reads out of the engine into the three homes Phase 2's boundary rule leaves open, from the engine's own module grouping rather than from a second hand-written list. REPORTS ONLY — exits non-zero on a name with no home or a cross-check disagreement, and the query group is a decision for Shantanu, not an output of this script.
scripts.comment:art:clay:check: The Clay pieces' contrast gate, on every verify and in CI (stage L3, docs/LOOK_PLAN.md section 13). Re-measures every committed render against the lit colour of the board and of the base's well, requires 3:1, and requires the committed manifest and output to be what those renders produce. It encodes nothing, so it takes seconds and answers the same on any machine. Without it the gate is a script somebody may run before committing a new piece. Controls: pnpm ci:selftest clay-gate-reads-the-pictures, clay-manifest-not-measured, clay-output-not-recorded; and pnpm art:clay --control for the gate's own mustFail and mustPass.
scripts.comment:turbo:check: The turbo hash guard. pnpm verify replayed a cached green over a red suite for thirteen days because the test task hashed only its own package (docs/FINDINGS.md #51). Asserts, from turbo's dry run, that every workspace test edge is in the hash graph. Control: pnpm ci:selftest turbo-test-hash.
scripts.comment:deps:check: The React pair. Dependabot moved react-dom to 19.3.0 and left react at 19.2.8; React refuses to start unless the two are the same version, and typecheck, lint, every suite and CI stayed green over a blank app (docs/FINDINGS.md #92). Reads pnpm-lock.yaml and requires every react-dom to be paired with the same react. In pnpm verify and in CI. Controls: pnpm ci:selftest react-pair-split, react-pair-unread, react-pair-moved-together.
scripts.comment:start:check: The start check (ruled 26 September 2026): a build that does not start is never deployed. Serves a built folder on 127.0.0.1, opens it in headless Chrome, and requires the title with no uncaught error; --build builds the app into a temporary folder first. Run by deploy-app.sh and old-build.sh before anything is copied (docs/FINDINGS.md #92). Controls: pnpm ci:selftest start-check-refuses, start-check-words-free.
scripts.comment:update:check: The update check (Update now, ruled 28 September 2026): the P3.6 morning replayed. Builds the app twice, serves the older build then the newer, has a stand-in relay refuse the phone on version (close code 4001), and requires Update now under that refusal to bring the newer build; a reload alone brings the older one back (docs/FINDINGS.md #93). Controls: pnpm ci:selftest update-check-reload-alone, update-check-no-button.
